'''Loposi Three's moon''' was a [[Moon/Legends|natural satellite]] of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Loposi Three]].<ref name="The Healing Moon" /> It was situated in the [[Loposi system/Legends|Loposi system]], a part of the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="The Healing Moon" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Along with the rest of the Loposi [[Star system/Legends|system]], the moon was located on the system of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Gevarno Loop]].<ref name="JvS" />

At some point, Loposi Three's moon was transformed to have an artificial [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of nutrient-rich [[Gas/Legends|gases]]. The moon's air was derived from liquid [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]]<ref name="The Healing Moon" />&mdash;a healing agent whose only known source was<ref name="CSWE kolto">{{CSWECite|II|224|kolto}}</ref> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="CSWE kolto" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Healing Moon" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to investigate the effects of the healing gases of Loposi Three's moon. The companion researched the effects on colonies of [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]], with the experiments leading to noteworthy [[Mutant|mutations]] in the organisms.<ref name="The Healing Moon" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Loposi Three's moon was introduced in a Bioanalysis Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="The Healing Moon" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Loposi system, and therefore the moon, in grid square M-18,<ref name="TEA" /> though the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book later changed the placement to grid square M-17 instead.<ref name="EAOC" />
